title: Web performance severely impacted when moving mouse over Chrome browser tabs
body:
### Tested versions

**In BROWSER:**

Brave 1.95.104 (Official Build) (x86_64)
Chromium: 153.0.8010.53
Linux Mint 22.3 - Cinnamon 64-bit

Godot Engine v4.7.1.stable.official.a13da4feb - https://godotengine.org
index.js:2 OpenGL API OpenGL ES 3.0 (WebGL 2.0 (OpenGL ES 3.0 Chromium)) - Compatibility - Using Device: WebKit - WebKit WebGL
index.js:2 Build configuration: Emscripten 4.0.20, single-threaded, no GDExtension support.


**DESKTOP:**

Godot Engine v4.7.1.stable.official.a13da4feb - https://godotengine.org
OpenGL API 4.6 (Core Profile) Mesa 25.2.8-0ubuntu0.24.04.2 - Compatibility - Using Device: AMD - AMD Radeon Graphics (radeonsi, gfx1200, LLVM 20.1.2, DRM 3.64, 7.0.0-31-generic)

No issues on Firefox.

**Hardware:**
⭐Linux Mint 22.3 - Cinnamon 64-bit
⭐AMD Ryzen 5 5500
⭐32 GB RAM
⭐AMD RX 9060XT 16GB
⭐Brave 1.95.104 (Official Build) (x86_64)
⭐Chromium: 153.0.8010.53


### System information

Godot Engine v4.7.1.stable.official.a13da4feb - https://godotengine.org index.js:2 OpenGL API OpenGL ES 3.0 (WebGL 2.0 (OpenGL ES 3.0 Chromium)) - Compatibility - Using Device: WebKit - WebKit WebGL index.js:2 Build configuration: Emscripten 4.0.20, single-threaded, no GDExtension support.

### Issue description

- Hovering mouse over other browser tabs reduces FPS (VSync) by 50%.  From 60FPS to 30FPS.
- Present in all projects tested.  Completely repeatable.
- Issue on Brave.  Firefox is OK.  
- Desktop versions get 600-800 FPS.

⭐⭐⭐YOUTUBE video showing complete tests:  https://youtu.be/Kl2cf7iyk-4
